# ruststream-amqp

> `ruststream-amqp` is the AMQP 1.0 broker crate for RustStream, a Rust framework for services that subscribe to message brokers and publish to them. AMQP 1.0 is an ISO standard, so one crate over the `fe2o3-amqp` client serves ActiveMQ Artemis and Classic, RabbitMQ 4.x, Azure Service Bus and Event Hubs, Amazon MQ, Solace, Apache Qpid and IBM MQ.

A subscription is the descriptor `AmqpAddress`: `AmqpAddress::queue` (anycast), `AmqpAddress::topic` (multicast) or `AmqpAddress::raw` (a verbatim address), with the settings of its link. A service file imports `ruststream_amqp::prelude::*`, which offers `AmqpPublish` as `Publish` along with the broker, its SASL profile and the capability traits `RequestReply` and, with the `transaction` feature, `TransactionalPublisher`. The `rustls` and `native-tls` features enable TLS for `amqps://` endpoints.

This site holds the entry pages. The crate's guide is its overview on docs.rs, and the framework itself is documented on the RustStream site.

## Site

- [Home](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-amqp/latest/): which brokers the crate serves, the dependency lines, the prelude and a first service
- [Benchmarks](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-amqp/latest/benchmarks/): what this crate and the framework's runtime cost over the raw `fe2o3-amqp` client, and how to re-measure it with `just bench`

## Guide

- [Overview](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html): the transport and a first service
- [Subscribing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#subscribing): the address descriptor, its terminus and link settings
- [Acknowledgement](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#acknowledgement): the disposition each handler outcome maps to
- [Capping the retries](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#capping-the-retries): the retry cap and where a spent delivery goes
- [Delayed redelivery](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#delayed-redelivery): the deferred re-publish behind `retry_after`
- [Batches](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#batches): batches assembled on the client
- [Publishing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#publishing): the publish policies and replies
- [Request/reply](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#requestreply): requests over a dynamic reply link
- [Transactions](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#transactions): transactional posting behind the `transaction` feature
- [The prelude](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#the-prelude): what a routes file and a handler body import
- [The generated document](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#the-generated-document): what the `asyncapi` feature reports
- [Testing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#testing): the in-process broker behind the `testing` feature, driven by `TestApp`
- [Operations](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp/latest/ruststream_amqp/index.html#operations): authentication, TLS, sessions and the known gaps
